name: 2d-platformer
description: Side-scrolling platformer starter: an ASCII-map level (scene.import_ascii) over a small tileset, run/jump player, coins with sounds, score HUD, follow camera clamped to the level, and a complete game shell: main menu, loading screen, pause menu, options (video, audio per bus, controls rebinding) saved in storage, credits; gamepad-only navigation; tests. Player and coins are Shape2D; the only binary assets are a tileset PNG and two tiny WAVs.
